---
name: RFC
about: Propose a new profile, drop a profile, or break existing packages
title: "RFC: "
labels: ["rfc", "status:proposed"]
---

## Problem

What is wrong or missing today?

## Proposal

What should change (tables, profile identifiers, validator rules, docs)?

## Affected profiles

Which of `land`, `rpdp`, `water`, `atmosphere`, `dark-sky`, `climate`, `attribution` (or core) are affected?

## Backward compatibility

What existing packages would fail or need a rewrite? Until 1.0, minor versions may break.

## Example

A row, a `datapackage.json` excerpt, or a pointer to `examples/`.

## Camtrap DP impact

Does a dual exporter have to change? If not, say none.
